about.headline: Deliciously Fulfilling & Economically Priced
about.short: A staple in Kennesaw for decades, Ru San's Kennesaw brings quality, fresh sushi and authentic flavors without breaking your bank.
about.long: Ru San’s, based in Kennesaw, GA since 2003, is the original mainstream Japanese seafood and sushi restaurant in the area. We are locally owned and operated and serve a variety of fresh sushi and seafood daily. Come and experience our casual and active atmosphere only 5 minutes from Kennesaw State University. We have free Wi-Fi and 5 flat-screen TV’s for your entertainment enjoyment. We serve lunch and dinner and offer catering and take-out. We welcome groups for special events such as birthdays, family reunions and business luncheons.

features.title: Appetizers
features.text: Aside from familiar staples like fried calamari, crab cakes or potstickers, we have some distinctive dishes to try like our popular Hot Wok Tiger Shrimp, "O" Face Lobster or Shisamo plate.

features.title: Artistically Crafted Rolls
features.text: Premium sushi rolls without the premium pricing. Sushi is meant to be enjoyed by all as a healthy meal, not just for the elite.

features.title: Hearty Entrées
features.text: Many diners see the value in our food: from deliciously healthy entrees with generous servings and artistic plating.

specials.text: Please check back periodically for specials or promotions. Feel free to contact us and ask to be part of our mailing list for deals.
specials.giveback: Ru San's Kennesaw is proud to give back to our community, contact us if you are a school or non profit interested in give back nights.
